standard: NIST IR 8259A / EN 303 645 Core IoT Capabilities

capabilities.title: Device Identification
capabilities.evidence: Unique MAC address and burned SHA-256 device certificate in eFuse.

capabilities.title: Device Configuration
capabilities.evidence: Protected NVS encrypted partition for local configuration items.

capabilities.title: Data Protection
capabilities.evidence: TLS 1.3 encryption on external MQTT telemetry, zero cleartext passwords.

capabilities.title: Logical Interface Access
capabilities.evidence: Authentication required on all REST API and MQTT endpoints.

capabilities.title: Software Update
capabilities.evidence: Dual-slot OTA with cryptographic signature validation before boot.

capabilities.title: Cybersecurity State Awareness
capabilities.evidence: Firmware records boot reasons, fault interrupts, and auth failure counts.
